data.description:
## Goal
As the team, we need proof that the full pack pipeline works end-to-end and that nothing regressed before the epic is considered done.

## Acceptance Criteria
- An integration test drives a fixture content directory through loader → merge → Main Street save/load, asserting the same pool is restored and that missing-pack degradation works.
- `npm test -- --project unit` passes in both repos and `npm run build` succeeds in both.
- The existing runtime game plugin loader/protocol tests still pass (no regression).
- A documented manual QA path verifies a packaged Electron run with an installed pack (installed/entitled, present/locked, missing).

## Minimal Implementation
- Integration test in the appropriate existing location plus a QA note; evidence comment on the parent item.

## Dependencies
- Main Street pack merge & persistence; Main Street pack listing UI & boot wiring.

## Deliverables
- Integration test + QA note + evidence comment.

## Test Plan
- Integration + the full unit profile + build.

- **Manual QA:** `docs/dev/card-packs-qa.md` (installed/entitled, present/locked, missing) linked from `docs/DEVELOPER.md`.
- **Gates:** core unit 194 files / 2982 tests green + build; tce-main-street unit 319 files / 5284 tests green + build; runtime game-plugin loader/protocol + card-pack targeted tests 261 green (no regression).

data.author: implement
data.comment:
F10 evidence — end-to-end verification & quality gate.

**Integration test (cross-repo):** tce-main-street `tests/main-street/CardPackPipelineIntegration.test.ts`, commit `5f48686` on `dev` (MS-0MV0Q479I002W0R6). It materialises the committed reference pack content directory and drives it through the real core `loadCardPacks` → `mergeMainStreetCardPool` (via `loadMainStreetCardPacks`) → apply → `serializeMainStreetState` → reset → `deserializeMainStreetState`, asserting the same templates/active-pack set/checksum are restored. Missing-pack degradation: a requested-but-absent pack yields a base-content pool plus a 'missing' warning, and `assertLiveTemplatesResolvable` refuses only when a live card instance needs the missing template.

**Manual QA path:** `docs/dev/card-packs-qa.md` (linked from `docs/DEVELOPER.md` § Card Packs) — packaged Electron run with an installed pack for installed/entitled, present/locked, lastimissing, and deny-by-default asset protocol scenarios.

**Verification:**
- tce-main-street: `npm test` (unit) 319 files / 5284 tests green; `npm run build` succeeds.
- core: `npx vitest run --project unit` 194 files / 2982 tests green; `npm run build` succeeds.
- No regression: card-pack + runtime game-plugin loader/protocol targeted run 14 files / 261 tests green (`tests/ui/card-pack-*.test.ts`, `tests/electron/{pack-protocol,card-pack-*}.test.ts`, `tests/ui/game-plugin-*.test.ts`, `tests/scripts/build-card-pack.test.ts`).
